To summarize, the key findings of our research, stated in one sentence that includes all relevant information, are that

market-driven business strategies are best achieved through the development of flexible production systems that have the following characteristics: a) the production system is integrated, b) the production system has a high degree of flexibility, c) the production system can be adapted rapidly to changing market demands, d) there is a high level of integration between the production and business strategies of the firm.

the successful design and development of flexible manufacturing systems requires the integration of subsystems (i.e. manufacturing, marketing, and human resources) and the development of an organizational culture that encourages organizational change and flexibility.

the successful implementation of flexible manufacturing in the electronics industry is dependent upon the development of an integrated, flexible and market-driven production system, and the design of a flexible organization that supports the implementation of such a system.
In summary, our research is concerned with
the development of flexible production systems and their relationship with market-driven strategies.
the design and implementation of production systems in the electronics industry.
the development of a theoretical framework for understanding how market-driven strategies and production systems are linked.
In summary, a comprehensive and detailed conclusive statement would be that

the development of a market-driven strategy is not only dependent on the development of a production system which can be flexible and adaptable but also on the development of an organizational structure that can facilitate this.
market-driven strategies and flexible production systems are not only interrelated, but are also highly dependent upon each other.
the market-driven business strategy and flexible manufacturing systems are inextricably linked.
A comprehensive summary for our work would be that

the development of market-driven production systems requires an integrated approach, which involves the simultaneous consideration of the strategic, technical, social and environmental aspects of the firm.
market-driven strategies and flexible manufacturing are not mutually exclusive, but are in fact complementary.

in order to develop a market-driven production system, the following conditions must be present: a) the firm must be able to identify and respond to customer needs, b) there must be a strong commitment to the development of flexible production systems, c) the firm must develop appropriate controls, and d) a supportive organizational culture must be developed.
The main takeaway from our work is that
the successful design of production systems is contingent on the design of the firm's strategy and organization.
the design of a production system is not a technical matter, but a social and organizational process.

the development and implementation of flexible manufacturing systems in the electronics industry is a process of organizational learning, in which the organization learns how to adapt to the complexity of its environment, and how to develop appropriate organizational structures to match this complexity.
